def grav(di, dr=1, dc=0):
    H,W=len(di),len(di[0]); res=[[None]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            v=di[r][c]
            if v==0: continue
            # fall from its position to lowest possible
            y=r
            while y+1<H and res[y+1][c] is None: y+=1
            res[y][c]=v
    return res

import os,re,json
from collections import deque
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    di=G[k+' input']; do=G[k+' output']
    print('==',k, 'in',len(di),len(di[0]),'out',len(do),len(do[0]))
    # find shapes: comps of colors !=4,5 in input; and bars in output
    ci=comps(di,skip=(4,5)); co=comps(do)
    for o in ci:
        pat=o['cells']
        ys=[y for y,_ in pat]; xs=[x for _,x in pat]
        h=max(ys)-min(ys)+1; w=max(xs)-min(xs)+1
        # row counts and col counts
        rc={i+1:sum(1 for (yy,x) in pat if yy+i+1>=0) for i in range(h)}  # placeholder
        def cnt(arr,n,m):
            a=[]
            for y in range(n):
                a.append(sum(1 for x in range(m) if arr[y][x]))
            return a
        M=[[1 if (y,x) in o['cells'] else 0 for x in range(w)] for y in range(h)]
        print('col',o['col'],'shape',(h,w),'cellcounts rows',cnt(M,h,w),'cols',cnt([list(r) for r in zip(*M)],w,h))
    print('--- OUT bars:')
    for b in co:
        ys=[y for y,_ in b['cells']]; xs=[x for _,x in b['cells']]
        h=max(ys)-min(ys)+1; w=max(xs)-min(xs)+1
        M=[[1 if (y,x) in b['cells'] else 0 for x in range(w)] for y in range(h)]
        print('col',b['col'],'shape',(h,w),'pat',M,'rcounts',cnt(M,h,w),'ccounts',cnt([list(r) for r in zip(*M)],w,h))

def feats(cells,bbox_h,bbox_w):
    ys=[y for y,_ in cells]; xs=[x for _,x in cells]
    P={(y-min(ys),x-min(xs)) for y,x in cells}
    def run(m,direction):
        best=0; cur=1
        for i in range(len(m)-1):
            if m[i][i+d]==1 and m[i+1][i+d]==1: cur+=1
            else: cur=1
            best=max(best,cur)
        return best
    # straight runs (orthogonal)
    rh=max([sum(1 for x in range(bbox_w) if (r,x) in P) for r in range(bbox_h)])
    cv=max([sum(1 for y in range(bbox_h) if (y,c) in P) for c in range(bbox_w)])
    md=max(sum(1 for i in range(min(a for a,_ in P)+1) if (a,a) in P) for a in range(max(ys)-min(ys)+1) if (a,a) in P) if False else 0
    md=0
    for start in range(bbox_h):
        if (start,start) in P:
            k=0
            while (start+k,start+k) in P: k+=1
            md=max(md,k)
    amd=0
    for start in range(bbox_h):
        if (start,bbox_w-1-start) in P:
            k=0
            while (start+k,bbox_w-1-start-k) in P: k+=1
            amd=max(amd,k)
    # rows/cols sums
    rs=[sum(1 for x in range(bbox_w) if (r,x) in P) for r in range(bbox_h)]
    cs_=[sum(1 for y in range(bbox_h) if (y,c) in P) for c in range(bbox_w)]

def load():
    import os,glob,re
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
# per-object exact masks & bar masks
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    di=G[k+' input']; do=G[k+' output']
    print('==',k)
    for o in objs(di):
        cs={(y,x) for y,x in o['cells']}
        ys=[y for y,_ in cs]; xs=[x for _,x in cs]
        h=max(ys)-min(ys)+1; w=max(xs)-min(xs)+1
        mask=tuple(tuple(1 if (r,c) in cs else 0 for c in range(w)) for r in range(h))
        bars=[b for b in comps(do) if b['col']==o['col']]
        lines=[]
        for b in bars:
            bc={(y,x) for y,x in b['cells']}
            bys=[y for y,_ in bc]; bx=[x for _,x in bc]
            bh=max(bys)-min(bys)+1; bw=max(bx)-min(bx)+1
            ml=tuple(tuple(1 if (r,c) in bc else 0 for c in range(bw)) for r in range(bh))
            orient='H' if bh==1 else ('V' if bw==1 else '?')
            lines.append((ml,orient,len(bc)))
        print('col=%d n=%d pos=(%d,%d) h=%d w=%d'%(o['col'],len(cs),min(ys),min(xs),h,w),mask)
        print('   bars:',lines)

    for axis in range(2):
        if axis==0:
            m=[[mask[i][j] for j in range(W)] for i in range(H)]
            cur=0; prev=None
            for i in range(H):
                for j in range(W):
                    v=m[i][j]; 
                    if v and (prev is None or v!=prev):
                        pass
                # simpler: scan linear
        pass
    return None
def feat_run(cells, diag=False):
    ys=[y for y,_ in cells]; xs=[x for _,x in cells]
    if diag:
        pts=sorted((y+x,y-x) for y,x in cells)
    else:
        pts=sorted((y,x) for y,x in cells)
    prev=None; best=0; cur=0
    for p in pts:
        if prev is not None and (p[0]==prev[0] and p[1]==prev[1]+1) if diag else False: continue
        cur+=1
        if cur>best: best=cur
        cur=1 if p==(prev[0],prev[1]+1) else 0
        prev=p
    return best

import os,re,json
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
def comps(g,bg=None,excl=None):
    seen=[[False]*len(g[0]) for _ in g]; out=[]
    for i in range(len(g)):
        for j in range(len(g[0])):
            if g[i][j]!=0 and not seen[i][j] and (bg is None or g[i][j]!=bg) and (excl is None or g[i][j]!=excl):
                st=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; cs=[]
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop(); cs.append((y,x))
                    for dy in(-1,0,1):
                        for dx in(-1,0,1):
                            ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                            if 0<=ny<len(g) and 0<=nx<len(g[0]) and not seen[ny][nx] and g[ny][nx]==g[i][j]:
                                seen[ny][nx]=True; st.append((ny,nx))
                out.append(dict(col=g[i][j],cells=cs,n=len(cs)))
    return out
# Use VERIFIED data from prior analysis: bar spec by color
SPEC={1:(3,'H'),2:(2,'H'),3:(4,'H'),6:(2,'V')}
def runs_and_runs(o):
    P=set(o['cells']); ys=[y for y,_ in P]; xs=[x for _,x in P]
    h=max(y for y,_ in P)-min(y for y,_ in P)+1; w=max(x for _,x in P)-min(x for _,x in P)+1
    m=[[1 if (min(y for y,_ in P)+i,min(x for _,x in P)+j) in P else 0 for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
    H=max(sum(r) for r in m); V=max(sum(c) for c in zip(*m)); D=max(m[i][j]+m[i+1][j+1] for i in range(h-1) for j in range(w-1))
    A=max(m[i][j]+m[i+1][j-1] for i in range(h-1) for j in range(1,w))
    return H,V,D,A

for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']:
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']
    print('==',k)
    for b in sorted(comps4(go),key=lambda c:(c['col'],min(c['cells']))):

                run=0; y,x=next(iter(pts))

def analyze(k):
    gi=G[k+' input']; go=G[k+' output']
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    bg=gi[0][-1]
    nb=[(y,x) for y in range(H) for x in range(W) if gi[y][x]==5]
    res=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    for r in go:
        for c,v in enumerate(r):
            res[r][c]=v
    print('==',k,'noise',nb)
    # adjacency graph of outbars
    bars=sorted([o for o in comps8(go) if o['col']!=5],key=lambda o:min(o['cells']))
    for i,b in enumerate(bars):
        pts=b['cells']
        adj=[j for j,o2 in enumerate(bars) if o2 is not b and any(abs(a-c)<=1 and abs(b-d)<=1 and (a,b)!=(c,d) for a,b in pts for c,d in o2['cells'])]
        print(' bar',i,'col',b['col'],'TL',min(pts),'len',len(pts),'adj',adj)
for k in ['Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2','Demo pair 3']: analyze(k)

def solve(gi):
    H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
    bg=gi[0][-1]
    maxc=max(x for r in gi for x,v in enumerate(r) if v!=bg and v!=5)
    crop=[r[:maxc+1] for r in gi]
    # objects: 8-connected components of non-bg colors (4 = separator; treat all non-bg as same color? use 8-connectivity on any non-bg)
    obs=sorted([o for o in comps(crop,conn=8) if len(o['cells'])>1], key=lambda o:min(o['cells']))
    specs={1:(3,'H'),2:(2,'H'),3:(4,'H'),6:(2,'V')}
    res=[[0]*(maxc+1) for _ in range(H)]
    placed=set()
    def barset(L,O,y,x): return {(y,x+i) for i in range(L)} if O=='H' else {(y+i,x) for i in range(L)}
    # anchor bar: the one with best placement under noise, maximizing overlap/touch count then min top-left
    npos=[(y,x) for y in range(H) for x in range(maxc+1) if crop[y][x]==5]
    best=None
    for i,o in enumerate(obs):
        L,O=specs[o['col']]
        for y in range(1,H):
            for x in range(maxc+1):
                cs=barset(L,O,y,x)
                cnt=sum(1 for p in cs if p in npos or any(abs(p[0]-a)<=1 and abs(p[1]-b)<=1 for a,b in npos))
                bestc=best if best is None else best
                if cnt>bestc[0] or (cnt==bestc[0] and (min(cs)<bestc[1])):
                    best=(cnt,min(min((p[0]+p[1] for p in cs)),y,x,cs))
    _,_,_,yy,xx,cs=best
    for p in cs: res[p[0]][p[1]]=obs[i]['col'] if False else None
    # redetermine
    i=best[3]; L,O=specs[obs[i]['col']]
    for p in cs: res[p[0]][p[1]]=obs[i]['col']
    placed=cs
    remaining=[o for j,o in enumerate(obs) if o is not obs[i]]
    import heapq
    while remaining:
        cur=[]
        for o in remaining:
            L,O=specs[o['col']]
            best_local=None
            for y in range(H):
                for x in range(maxc+1):
                    cs_=barset(L,O,y,x)
                    if cs_ & placed: continue
                    # adjacency score: touch placed cells? prefer 8-adjacency chain
                    adj=max(sum(1 for a,b in cs_ for c,d in placed if max(abs(a-c),abs(b-d))==1), default=0)
                    key=(-adj, min(p[0]+p[1] for p in cs_), y, x)
                    if best_local is None or key<best_local[0]: best_local=(key,cs_)
            cur.append(best_local)
        cur.sort(key=lambda t:t[0][0])
        k,cs_=cur[0]
        if k[0]<=-1000: break
        for p in cs_: res[p[0]][p[1]]= [o for o in remaining if True][0]  # placeholder bug
        remaining.remove(cur[0][1][5] if False else remaining[cur.index(cur[0])])
    return res

def decomp(pts):
    # split 8-comp into maximal straight orthogonal runs (H/V), preferring longer
    s=set(pts)
    runs=[]
    used=set()
    for p in sorted(pts):
        if p in used: continue
        best=None
        for dr,dc,name in [(0,1,'H'),(1,0,'V')]:
            L=1; y,x=p
            while True:
                ny,nx=y+dr,x+dc
                if (ny,nx) in s and (ny,nx) not in used:
                    L+=1; y,x=ny,nx
                else: break
            if best is None or L>best[0]: best=(L,name,p)
        if best:
            L,nm,(r,c)=best
            seg=[(r,c+i) for i in range(L)]
            used.update(seg)
            runs.append((nm,L,r,c))
    return runs
